facts.text: Evan plans to try poutine during his trip.

evidence.quote: Yeah, Sam! Gonna try some poutine while we're there - can't wait!
Never tried it? Can't say I blame you, it's kind of a Canadian thing.

facts.text: Evan and Sam are planning to communicate about their trip experiences.
